pipeline_config.description: Authoritative frozen configuration for Smartphone Intelligent Dead Reckoning (SIH) pipeline

route_matcher.disabled_reason: Arclength tangent extrapolation causes large endpoint overshoot under speed scale drift (+31% regression on Sc 12); relative ratio lacks absolute goodness-of-fit discrimination.

route_matching_status.rationale: Diagnostics proved route matching degraded median drift from 11.59% to 12.78% and caused severe regressions on scenarios #12, #13, #25, #39 due to speed-scale tangent overshooting and missing absolute cost discrimination. Remains disabled by default.
